highlights: Profitability $0.7B GAAP operating income $0.8B GAAP net income $1.7B non-GAAP net income1 In Q3, we maintained strong momentum on many projects spanning Super Intelligence (SI), robotics and renewable energy that will be critical to building a future of Amazing Abundance.
Revenue Total quarterly revenue was roughly flat YoY at $28.0B.

Strength in our core business also continued, and we achieved our second consecutive quarter of TTM revenue in excess of $100B. deliveries in North America – our most mature market – a nearly twenty percentage point sequential increase.

Cash Operating cash flow of $6.3B Free cash flow2 of $1.5B $1.9B increase in our cash and investments3 Operations Produced and delivered our 10 millionth vehicle Launched Cybercab into the Robotaxi fleet in Austin Record production at Gigafactory Berlin

FX impact1) + lower restructuring and other expenses + higher automotive ancillary sales, primarily driven by an increase in FSD subscriptions + positive FX impact of $0.1B1 Cash Quarter-end cash, cash equivalents and short-term investments was $45.4B.
